subject.title: feat: add tools.fs.roots — per-agent filesystem roots with access modes

question: Should OpenClaw accept `tools.fs.roots` as the core config and Plugin SDK direction for granular host filesystem/media access after the explicit-root widening bug is fixed?
rationale: The implementation adds a new operator-facing security/config model and public media-runtime seam; automation can repair the concrete bug, but only maintainers should decide whether this is the permanent core API surface.

options.title: Sponsor after boundary repair
options.body: Fix the explicit-root widening blocker, refresh the branch against current `main`, and proceed with maintainer review of the new core config and SDK surface.

options.title: Split into design follow-up
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for a narrower design issue or smaller PR sequence before accepting the config/API surface.

options.title: Decline core surface
options.body: Close or redirect the approach if maintainers want this capability handled through a different plugin, sandbox, or deployment boundary instead of core config.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after boundary repair
recommendation.body: Fix the explicit-root widening blocker, refresh the branch against current `main`, and proceed with maintainer review of the new core config and SDK surface.
